events.factual_description: Pioneer Works presents Colin Stetson and Brìghde Chaimbeul in its Main Hall on Tuesday, September 15, 2026. Doors are at 7:00 PM and the performance starts at 8:00 PM; admission is general admission, standing room only. Pioneer Works describes the duo's live performance of All the light in the world as music built from deep listening and improvisation, merging Stetson's saxophone approach with Chaimbeul's Scottish smallpipes across drone, ritual, and cinematic textures. The Space Lady and Clarice Jensen are also billed. Colin Stetson's artist-owned Bandcamp page lists the album for release on September 11, 2026 and credits all songs as written and performed by Stetson and Chaimbeul. Apple Music also lists the eight-song album as a September 11, 2026 pre-release.

en.why_it_matters: A saxophone and Scottish-smallpipes duo should feel improbable; here the shared language is breath, drone, pulse, and physical resonance. Stetson and Chaimbeul bring their new collaborative album to Pioneer Works four days after release, turning two intensely individual instrumental practices into music built for sustained listening and improvisational pressure. The Space Lady and Clarice Jensen make the surrounding bill unusually coherent rather than merely eclectic.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is already plausible, I would organize the Brooklyn night around this set. From the DMV, I would pair it with another strong New York reason rather than make the corridor trip solely for this one date.
en.listen_before: Colin Stetson & Brìghde Chaimbeul — All the light in the world

es.why_it_matters: Un dúo de saxofón y smallpipes escocesas debería sonar improbable; aquí el idioma común es respiración, drone, pulso y resonancia física. Stetson y Chaimbeul llevan a Pioneer Works su nuevo disco colaborativo apenas cuatro días después de publicarlo, convirtiendo dos maneras muy personales de tocar en música hecha para la escucha sostenida y la presión de la improvisación. The Space Lady y Clarice Jensen hacen que el resto del cartel tenga una lógica experimental muy clara, no una mezcla al azar.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York ya está en juego, organizaría la noche de Brooklyn alrededor de este concierto. Desde el DMV lo combinaría con otra razón fuerte para subir, en vez de hacer el viaje del corredor únicamente por esta fecha.
